techniques.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/checks_tests.rs:371 The test named a_ledger_change_after_the_summary_makes_its_real_hash_stale_for_every_money_decision manually lists six non-void variants; completeness is not mechanically tied to the Decision definition.
